\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{દવાખાનું} (davākhānũ)}{દવાખાનું (davākhānũ)}]{\gu{દવાખાનું} (davākhānũ) — a clinic, a dispensary}

\label{lesson:GU-C84-clinic}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for how much, then the Gujarati for which one.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{દવાખાનું}}
\textbf{\gu{દવાખાનું}} (\emph{davākhānũ}) — \textquotedblleft{}a clinic, a dispensary\textquotedblright{}. Where the \textbf{\gu{દવા}} is.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{દવાખાનું}} (\emph{davākhānũ}) is a compound of two loans: \emph{davā}, \textquotedblleft{}medicine\textquotedblright{}, from Arabic \emph{dawāʾ}, \textquotedblleft{}remedy\textquotedblright{} (Lane, root \emph{d-w-y}), and \emph{khānũ}, from Persian \emph{khāna}, \textquotedblleft{}house\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for around town.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{davākhānũ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{davākhānũ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for how much, then the Gujarati for which one, then say \emph{davākhānũ} again
\end{itemize}
